data.standardized_narrative: The 2016 and prior years of account were closed via a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) agreement, resulting in a gross strengthening of GBP 30.377m. This additional cost was recognized due to anticipated run-off costs and underlying adverse claims development, particularly in Hull, Cargo, and D&O/E&O classes. The 2017 year of account was significantly impacted by natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and the Mexican Earthquake.
